prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with wrist fracture after a rear-end collision. The patient had 3 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1260; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Imaging and exam findings clearly confirm the injury.
- Years ago the patient had a small strain in the same area that healed fully.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presented following a rear-end motor vehicle collision with a complaint of pain and limited motion in the left wrist. Examination findings were consistent with the mechanism of injury, and the reported injury corresponds well to the kind and force of the crash. Radiographs clearly confirmed a distal radius fracture with no displacement requiring operative intervention. The patient was immobilized in a splint and given a standard course of anti-inflammatory medication and hand therapy exercises. Over three visits, symptoms steadily improved, and care was tapered as range of motion and grip strength returned toward baseline. A remote history of a minor wrist strain in the same region, which resolved completely without lasting limitation, was noted during intake. Billing for this episode reflects the expected services for these three visits, with no repeated or duplicate charges. Patient is expected to return to full activity with routine follow-up as needed.
